schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE ACTIVITY (
    PLAYER_ID INT,
    EVENT_DATE DATE,
    DEVICE_ID INT,
    GAMES_PLAYED INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE),
    CHECK (GAMES_PLAYED >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT A1.FIRST_LOGIN AS INSTALL_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN (A1.FIRST_LOGIN + 1) = A2.EVENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/ COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID)), 2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM (SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS FIRST_LOGIN FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID) AS A1 JOIN ACTIVITY AS A2 ON A1.PLAYER_ID = A2.PLAYER_ID GROUP BY A1.FIRST_LOGIN
q2: WITH INSTALL AS ( SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) INSTALL_DT FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID ) SELECT INSTALL_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT I.PLAYER_ID) INSTALLS, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN A.EVENT_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(DISTINCT I.PLAYER_ID), 2) DAY1_RETENTION FROM INSTALL I LEFT JOIN ACTIVITY A ON A.PLAYER_ID = I.PLAYER_ID AND I.INSTALL_DT=A.EVENT_DATE-1 GROUP BY INSTALL_DT

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because they handle the calculation of DAY1_RETENTION differently. Q1 uses a CASE statement within the SUM function to count players who made an event on the day after their first login, while Q2 uses a LEFT JOIN to achieve the same result.
